# WOF fixtures

`xpress4k-small.wof.b64` was generated with wimlib commit
`cd5e231c348c255ae5088873b5a66ee0eb96fa07`. It contains three independently
compressed XPRESS-Huffman chunks representing
`WOF pinned XPRESS4K payload 0123456789\n` repeated 300 times.

The decoded 11,700-byte payload has SHA-256
`1c3dd0c10f3b2993df240e556984e2461238d60b4b6fc2478e8845c431e6bfe3`;
the 875-byte WofCompressedData stream has SHA-256
`184c60b9e8df5815da14a4bb26c5ce8db72abb6dc9468789ca0b0fe4dcb50b20`.
